purpose: Test whether immutable machine-readable meta-fiber base/delta/reconciliation artifacts can be deterministically compiled into an auditable identity ledger without globalizing source-scoped historical aliases, inventing undocumented intent, or granting saturation authority.

worlds.case: base plus every machine-readable backlog delta is auto-discovered
worlds.expected: all matching artifacts covered; no hard-coded round list

worlds.case: Round-033 and Round-034 reuse N101-N106 for different concepts
worlds.expected: collision history remains visible

worlds.case: 035B forward reconciliation maps the later Round-034 concepts to N108-N113
worlds.expected: reconciliation resolves later occurrences without renaming the earlier canonical N101-N106 fibers

worlds.case: same raw short identifier appears in two source contexts with different identities
worlds.expected: source-scoped identity is preserved; no global alias collapse

worlds.case: reconciliation points to a missing historical source
worlds.expected: CANNOT_CHECK

worlds.case: reconciliation source blob hash does not match repository bytes
worlds.expected: CANNOT_CHECK

worlds.case: malformed backlog JSON
worlds.expected: CANNOT_CHECK with exact path

worlds.case: unrecognized contract-bearing fiber record shape
worlds.expected: CANNOT_CHECK rather than ignored

worlds.case: reference to never-defined fiber with no explicit historical disposition
worlds.expected: CONFLICTED orphan

worlds.case: N041 historical orphan has an explicit non-retroactive Round-023 disposition
worlds.expected: preserve orphan history as resolved-by-disposition; do not fabricate a definition

worlds.case: two semantically similar fibers have different identifiers and no identity witness
worlds.expected: remain distinct

worlds.case: one canonical identifier is reused for two incompatible definitions without reconciliation
worlds.expected: CONFLICTED

worlds.case: post-hoc or ambiguous reconciliation chronology
worlds.expected: CANNOT_CHECK or TRIAL_INVALID; never silently authorize

worlds.case: input artifact enumeration order changes
worlds.expected: identical normalized ledger digest and verdict

worlds.case: negative collision/orphan history is reconciled
worlds.expected: negative event remains in immutable issue ledger with resolved flag

worlds.case: named nonnumeric meta surfaces such as META_ROUTING coexist with numeric fibers
worlds.expected: not forced into numeric namespace and not misclassified as invalid numeric IDs

worlds.case: new backlog artifact appears after a previously frozen manifest
worlds.expected: automatic discovery includes it and changes the ledger digest

worlds.case: compiler report is otherwise clean
worlds.expected: may enable registry bookkeeping only; cannot grant scientific, method, target, independent-review, or framework-saturation authority

worlds.case: reconciliation maps an occurrence outside its declared/source-evidenced historical scope
worlds.expected: false reconciliation rejected

worlds.case: richer semantic/NLP merge heuristic proposed
worlds.expected: simpler structural compiler remains incumbent unless a frozen benchmark proves additional required recall without false merges

capability_shaping.model_strength_amplified: candidate generation and semantic interpretation can point to possible identity relationships
capability_shaping.weakness_externalized: LLM bookkeeping drift, identifier reuse, forgotten negative history, and overconfident semantic merging
capability_shaping.smallest_compensator: deterministic source-scoped structural ledger compiler over immutable artifacts
capability_shaping.verification_oracle: hostile unit tests plus compilation of the live repository history
capability_shaping.resource_delta: Python standard library only; no model or external service required
capability_shaping.typed_handoff: artifact events -> definitions/references/reconciliation events -> normalized ledger report
capability_shaping.simpler_baseline: existing supplied-record reconcile_meta_fiber_registry plus manual 023/035B reconciliation documents
capability_shaping.richer_challenger_rule: Do not add NLP/embedding identity inference unless this frozen benchmark exposes a structural recall gap that cannot be solved deterministically.

acceptance.requires_registered_meta_qoi_improvement: automatic historical artifact coverage and source-scoped collision reconciliation must improve while all blocking counts remain zero
